title: Friday Daily Practice
subtitle: Review B8 (student life words, he/she -s, does / doesn't) and get ready for B9
theme: Review · Student life, getting ready for Hobbies
source: Foundation 11 lesson plan, week 6 (B8 Putting it all together, B9 Hobbies and free time), 2026-11-20
intro: Four steps, about 15 minutes. Deadline: 23:00. Steps 1 and 2 review Lesson 8. Step 3 shows 4 words for Saturday's lesson: it is OK to guess. Step 4 is a voice note.
send_today: Four steps on the website. The voice note is sent to the teacher when you press Submit.

steps.title: Step 1 · Student life words
steps.instructions: Write the missing word from this week. The first letter is given.

items.label: 1. I share my room with my r____. She is from Huế.
2. The new s____ starts in September and finishes in January.
3. I work in a café on Saturdays. It's my part-time j____.
4. Our l____ speaks slowly, so I can take notes.
5. Please h____ in your essay before Friday.
6. My brother wants to m____ in business at university.

steps.title: Step 2 · he / she + -s, does / doesn't
steps.instructions: Write the correct form of the verb in brackets. Use one or two words.

items.label: 1. My roommate ____ (get) up at six every day.
2. Our lecturer ____ (teach) three classes on Monday.
4. ____ your classmate live in a hall of residence? (Do / Does)
5. He ____ (not / eat) in the cafeteria. He cooks at home.

steps.title: Step 3 · New words for Saturday
steps.instructions: These 4 words are from Saturday's lesson (Hobbies and free time). Choose the best meaning. It is OK to guess.

items.explain: be into = like something very much. I'm really into K-pop = I like K-pop very much.

items.q: 2. binge-watch (I binge-watched a whole series last weekend.)

options.A: watch a film at the cinema
options.C: watch many episodes of a show one after another

items.explain: binge-watch = watch many episodes of a show, one after another, often in one night.

items.q: 3. go hiking (We often go hiking in Ba Vì.)

options.A: go for a long walk in the mountains or the countryside
options.B: go to a party with friends
options.C: go shopping in a big city

items.explain: go hiking = go for a long walk in the mountains or the countryside, often with a backpack.

items.q: 4. kill time (I play games on my phone to kill time.)
items.explain: kill time = do something easy while you wait, for example when the bus is late.

steps.title: Step 4 · Speaking Part 1
steps.instructions: Answer the 3 questions. Give 2 or 3 sentences for each answer, with a reason (because ...). Use at least 2 words from this week. Record one voice note.
lines: 2. Do you have a part-time job? Why or why not?
3. What do you do after class?
steps.note: No fixed answer. Teacher listens for 2 to 3 sentences, because, words from this week, correct he/she -s and doesn't.
